journal_lines: §lSpider§l on the ceiling. Dropped before I passed under. Didn't get the chance.
Cleared the web first, then the spider behind it.
Fast. Got faster when it saw me. Dealt with it anyway.
§cLanded on my back. §oLegs were everywhere at once.§o Rolled it off. Finished it.
Two of them in a low tunnel. Handled in order.
§oWalked into silk before I saw the web.§o The strands hum when you pull at them. Located it by sound.
Eight eyes and none of them looking anywhere useful. Felled it.
Came down a thread right in front of me. Put it down before it touched ground.
§lSpider§l in the corner, still as the wall behind it. Smelled it before I saw it.
Nursery in a side passage. Too many. Took the long way.
Legs kept moving after it fell. Stepped clear and waited.
§oEyes caught the light before the body resolved out of the dark.§o Backed up. Changed my angle.
